assistantSettings.title: Assistant
assistantSettings.intro: The assistant (<icon></icon> in the sidebar, or <shortcut></shortcut>) uses an AI model with your own API key; the provider bills you for what you use. What the assistant looks up (tasks, events, notes) is sent to that provider.
assistantSettings.serverKey: You can use the app's own key ({limit} messages a day). Add yours to use it without a limit.
assistantSettings.cantStore: This server can't store API keys yet (ASSISTANT_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set).
assistantSettings.baseUrlHint: Any service with an OpenAI-compatible chat API. A server on your own computer (LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1) only works while developing Nestery locally.
assistantSettings.apiKeyOptional: API key (if the server needs one)
assistantSettings.stored: It's stored encrypted and only used for your own requests.
assistantSettings.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
assistantSettings.modelPlaceholder: Load the list, or type a model id
assistantSettings.modelsHint: Lists the models your key can use, which also checks the key. Pick one that supports tool calling; small local models may misuse the tools.

subs.description: Bring calendars from elsewhere into Nestery: subscribe to a link to keep one in sync, or import a file once.
subs.title: Subscriptions
subs.hint: Shown next to your own events, read-only: a class timetable, your iPhone's calendar, sports fixtures… Paste its iCalendar (.ics or webcal) link. It refreshes every hour.
subs.whereLink: Where do I find a calendar's link?
subs.ade: ADE (university timetables): open your timetable, choose the export / “Exporter l’agenda” option, generate the URL and copy it.
subs.icloud: iPhone / iCloud: in the Calendar app, tap Calendars, then ⓘ next to the calendar, turn on “Public Calendar” and share the link. Anyone with that link can see the calendar.
subs.google: Google Calendar: Settings → the calendar → “Secret address in iCal format”.
subs.outlook: Outlook: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish a calendar → ICS link.
subs.failed: Last refresh failed: {error}. Showing the last copy that worked.
subs.needNameLink: Give the calendar a name and paste its link

home.title: A calm home for your everyday.
